strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. All allies destroyed. 2. Victory conditions not met within 12 turns.
What? Everything around us just went weird!?
We were just cruising normally...? What happened?
Unable to determine current coordinates.
Impossible. And this is where Beauty's bringing supplies from Anaheim...
it's our rendezvous point.
We don't know where we are? You mean we're lost!?
But it all looks strange too. This is more than just getting lost.
Could it be... Beauty too!?
We don't know where we are? But this situation...
Right... this view isn't normal. Could Beauty have ended up here too!?
Feels like we've wandered into some kind of other dimension.
Rom, this is...
Yes, it's like our battle at Tenku Majo on Planet Cronos.
Ten-ku-ma-jo? What an ominous name. A demon castle in the sky?
That's right. In other words... an artificial other dimension.
But this time seems different.
I doubt it's a vacation invite to thank us for all our hard work,
but...
No, this doesn't look like any vacation. This method...
Hoshino, what are the magnetic fields like?
Yes... the surrounding magnetic field is heavily distorted.
A magnetic field big enough to surround all of us...!?
Banjo, do you know something about this!?
Yes... Warping the magnetic field in normal space to make a special one...
if it's not the Gyandlar Rom mentioned... it's their method.
"Their"... You mean the Meganoids.
Meganoids... Those guys who showed up on Mars!
All hands, prepare to launch! Hurry!
That evil giant cyborg army!
Let's take 'em out with the power of justice!
Agreed. ...They went to the trouble of inviting us.
It'd be rude not to come out now.
Banjo...?
Brother, what's wrong? Why the face?
Banjo... He seemed different from usual.
Huh? Isn't he just his usual self?
There's no telling what will happen! All hands, stay alert! Sortie!
Okaaay! Aestivalis team, you're up toooo!
(She'll be here... With a scheme this big, she'll come in person...!)
Hm? While I was testing my collection in this space,
they've already deployed their forces?
Commander Benmel, is it? You didn't make this space on your own!
And you're going to tell me where you've hidden my assistant!
Heh heh heh, whatever do you mean!
Shouldn't you worry about yourself instead?
Today I'll finally add that Daitarn to my collection!
What's with him? He's definitely a Meganoid, but...
Some kind of otaku?
Fool! I am no otaku! Call me a collector!
...Ooh, Londo Bell has plenty of beautiful machines
that the Gandor's unit doesn't have...
Looks like the type who drifts off into his own little world...
Ah! Mustn't, mustn't... Right! Even if it takes my entire collection,
I'll make every last one of you part of my new collection!
I won't let things go the way you want...!
Right. If you're collecting, I'd recommend a beauty like me!
Ho ho ho, in that case, I'd prefer a younger girl.
Excuse me!? I'm only 21!
Omoikane, data search. ...She's shaving off two years.
......Could we have a little chat later, Ruri-Ruri?
Depends on the terms. Anyway, we have a bigger problem.
Huh?
How long this space will last, maybe?
Correct. In ten... twelve minutes, to be exact, we return to normal space.
Then if we just hold out, won't we get back to where we were?
Is it really that simple?
Then it seems we can't just leave it alone and wait to return...
Right. There's no telling what the shock of the distortion ending will do.
What are you all muttering about!?
Nothing at all, Commander Benmel. Now, let's begin!
Where you took my assistant... and more importantly, I want the boss
behind you... to come out within twelve minutes...!
What was that?
I... I've been defeated...!?
Too bad. Your collection won't be growing after all.
Nooooo... My... my precious collectiooon...
He was kind of hard to hate, though...
Yes. But that's what becomes of someone
who can no longer control his own desires.
Th-that's...! The super-busty Meganoid!
The Meganoid woman commander... we met on Mars.
That's Diondra of the Meganoids, right?
A trap this elaborate... I see, so a big fish does come out.
What!? So there were reinforcements after all!
Heh... So there were reinforcements!
...I've been waiting to see you, Koros.
What's that supposed to mean! ...Lady Koros, no need to come yourself...
As I thought, Londo Bell has gathered its strength...
It seems too much for Benmel alone.
Banjo... Why won't you understand the Don... no, the Meganoids?
You are...
Enough! I will never forgive the Meganoids... or Don Zauser!
Banjo seems kind of different from usual...
He was like that before too, when we fought the Meganoids on Mars...
It seems there's nothing more to say... Prepare yourself, Banjo.
Too bad, Koros. I'm the stubborn type who never gives up!
I haven't come without a plan, either...
We'll see. Whatever your plan, you can't stop us.
...Oh, right, let me ask you one thing. Seen my assistant anywhere?
Whatever do you mean? Heh heh heh...
(If my hunch is right... Koros's plan is probably...)
Ngh! ...If you insist on getting in the Don's way... then look at this!
Noooo!
Beauty! Koros... I knew it, you...!
That's... Banjo's...!?
As I suspected... it seems this was all arranged.
Getting swallowed into another dimension here was no accident...
That's dirty! A hostage!?
Banjo! This woman's life is in my hands! Stop resisting!
Kyaaaah!!
Killing one woman won't change anything!
...I think it's a fine way to get Banjo's life.
Banjo! Run!!
Banjo! Stop resisting! Or I'll crush this woman's head!
Banjo! Don't worry about me!
Be quiet!
I-I don't want to see Banjo taking orders from a woman like her!
...Beauty... I'm sorry...!
Huh!?
Banjo!?
I'm not cool enough to save Beauty and beat Koros at the same time.
You don't mean... Banjo?
I can't let this one chance slip away. I can't afford to.
Hey! Isn't there some way to save her!? Come on, Banjo!
Beauty, when you die, I'll make it quick. You won't suffer.
Please do...!
Koros... If anything, now that you've stopped moving is my chance...!
...Banjo's killing intent... It's real...!?
Banjo!
This isn't a game, Koros.
Kill her if you're going to kill her!
Stop it! Banjo!
Beauty!!
...Ngh!
Banjo!
......Very well.
Huh? Eek!
What!? She let the hostage go!?
...Banjo, I understand your resolve. But... is it truly resolve?
What...?
Isn't it just your self-righteousness, wanting to destroy the Don,
me, and us Meganoids by any means necessary?
What is she getting at...?
Banjo?
If that's so... then you are...
Get out of my sight, Koros.
...Very well. That was a meaningful time, Banjo.
Next time we meet... I swear!
...You can't kill me.
Looks like that's all of them.
Yeah. But how do we get out of this space...?
No need to worry. It's gradually returning to normal...
It seems some force is correcting the space properly.
Huh!? So it'll return to normal soon?
Yes. In under ten minutes, we'll be back in normal space.
The spatial distortion seems to be getting corrected as it reverts.
What? Then there was no need to hurry at all!
Feels like we rushed for nothing.
No, I suspect... Banjo?
...Yes, it seems Koros arranged it that way.
Seems she doesn't want to owe us anything. That's just like her.
I'm relieved to hear that. But Banjo, that was quite a performance.
Yeah! And Big Bro Rom played along with the act too.
You totally fooled me.
You knew doing that would make the enemy let the hostage go, right?
Right, Brother?
Rom?
No, I was serious.
Whaaat? Th-then that was...
Yes. ...I was serious.
Th-then, if that Koros hadn't backed off...!?
Stop. You shouldn't ask any more than that.
It's fine. Like I said before,
I'd hate to see Banjo do whatever someone like her tells him.
Heh, I'll never understand grown-ups.
Banjo... so, you know.
Yes, I'm glad you're safe... Beauty.
(Such decisiveness... Impressive.
Even if she is his own assistant, to build that much trust...
...Still, something doesn't quite add up.)
All right, everyone return to the ship.
There's no telling what'll happen when the space reverts. Hurry!
Oh, right. The transport ship I came on
made an emergency landing at that base.
I think the cargo's fine, so pick it up on your way.
That's a help. ...Still, that was quite a holdup,
just to pick up some supplies.
Speaking of supplies... I got some from Nergal.
New frames for the Aestivalis, ammo, that kind of thing.
New frames!? Nice! I was just itching for a power-up!
Speaking of supplies... I got some from Anaheim.
New mobile suits, ammo, that kind of thing.
Aw, man, mobile suits?
You should've gotten something cool, like a Gekigan Frame!
Well, we beat that collector creep. Wasn't a total waste, right?
Still, the Meganoids... they're a frightening enemy...
Nah... I'll crush their ambitions, no matter what.
In the end... they're just Meganoids. They can't even rein in their egos...
Failures, that's all. Right, Koros...?
